examples.chinese: A:對不起？ B:沒關係。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ? B: Méi guānxi.
examples.english: A: Sorry? B: It's okay.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 醫生說你肩膀疼的原因，是因為長時間打電腦的關係。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nǐ jiānbǎng téng de yuányīn, shì yīnwèi cháng shíjiān dǎ diànnǎo de guānxì.
examples.english: The doctor said the reason your shoulder hurts is because of using the computer for a long time.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng de guānxì, Xià xiǎojiě yǐjīng yǒu yī duàn shíjiān méi shàngjiē gòuwù le.
examples.english: Because she is too busy with work, Miss Xia has not gone out shopping for some time.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.
examples.english: After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.
examples.english: Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: 他們在裡面談話，你現在不要進去。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài lǐmiàn tánhuà, nǐ xiànzài búyào jìnqù.
examples.english: They are talking inside; don't go in now.

examples.chinese: 房東給了我鑰匙，明天就可以搬進去了。
examples.pinyin: Fángdōng gěi le wǒ yàoshi, míngtiān jiù kěyǐ bān jìnqù le.
examples.english: The landlord gave me the key, so I can move in tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Māma bù zài, wǎnfàn wǒ děi zìjǐ nòng. Dìdi bǎ fángjiān nòng de yòu zāng yòu luàn, shéi yě bù xiǎng jìnqù.
examples.english: Mom isn't home, so I have to make dinner myself. My little brother made the room both dirty and messy; no one wants to go in.

examples.pinyin: Kànbìng yǐqián yào xiān guàhào, zài zhào hàomǎ jìnqù kàn yīshēng. Bìngrén děi xiān guà le hào cái kěyǐ kànbìng.
examples.english: Before seeing a doctor, you must first register, then go in according to your number to see the doctor. Patients must first register before they can see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 圖書館入口那裡寫著不能帶食物進去，你吃完再進去吧。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn rùkǒu nàlǐ xiězhe bù néng dài shíwù jìnqù, nǐ chī wán zài jìnqù ba.
examples.english: At the library entrance, it says you can't bring food in, so finish eating before you go in.

examples.chinese: 他說的話都很有道理，不是廢話，只是你聽不進去而已。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà dōu hěn yǒu dàolǐ, bù shì fèihuà, zhǐshì nǐ tīng bù jìnqù éryǐ.
examples.english: What he says is all very reasonable, not nonsense; it's just that you won't take it in.

examples.chinese: 有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē yùndòng zhōngxīn guīdìng gèrén děi dài zìjǐ de máojīn, fǒuzé bù kěyǐ jìnqù.
examples.english: Some sports centers require individuals to bring their own towels; otherwise, they cannot enter.

examples.chinese: 我沒有帶大門的鑰匙，不得不攀牆進去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu dài dàmén de yàoshi, bùdébù pān qiáng jìnqù.
examples.english: I didn't bring the key to the main door, so I had no choice but to climb over the wall to get in.

examples.chinese: 我在喝粥時習慣加一些芝麻進去，喝起來很香。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài hē zhōu shí xíguàn jiā yīxiē zhīma jìnqù, hē qǐlái hěn xiāng.
examples.english: When I drink congee, I'm used to adding some sesame seeds; it tastes very fragrant.

items.wordHook: 進(advance) + 去(go) → advance and go in: to go in, to enter.

examples.chinese: 今天晚會上的表演都非常好看。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnhuì shàng de biǎoyǎn dōu fēicháng hǎokàn.
examples.english: The performances at today's evening event are all very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 他的表演很有意思，我們大家看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de biǎoyǎn hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒmen dàjiā kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: His performance is very interesting, we all watched it very happily.

examples.chinese: 今年的表演比去年的更有意思，我覺得你應該來看。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de biǎoyǎn bǐ qùnián de gèng yǒu yìsi, wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi lái kàn.
examples.english: This year's performance is even more interesting than last year's; I think you should come see it.

examples.chinese: 世界文化日那天，你想表演什麼？
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Wénhuà Rì nà tiān, nǐ xiǎng biǎoyǎn shénme?
examples.english: On World Culture Day, what do you want to perform?

examples.chinese: 他吹笛子吹得很好，辦過幾場很成功的音樂表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuī dízi chuī de hěn hǎo, bànguò jǐ chǎng hěn chénggōng de yīnyuè biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: He plays the flute very well and has held several very successful music performances.

examples.chinese: 越南同學的表演太棒了，我們一直拍手叫好！
examples.pinyin: Yuènán tóngxué de biǎoyǎn tài bàng le, wǒmen yìzhí pāishǒu jiàohǎo!
examples.english: The Vietnamese classmate's performance was so great that we kept clapping and cheering!

examples.chinese: 那個明星演戲前都會先研究戲裡的人物、故事，最後才決定表演的方式。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng yǎnxì qián dōu huì xiān yánjiū xì lǐ de rénwù, gùshì, zuìhòu cái juédìng biǎoyǎn de fāngshì.
examples.english: Before that star acts in a drama, he always first studies the characters and story in the play, and only then decides on the way to perform.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme huódòng zhōngxīn lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu? Jīntiān bú shì yǒu jítā shè de biǎoyǎn ma? B: Nǐ gǎo cuò le, yǎnchū rìqī shì xià ge xīngqīsān.
examples.english: A: Why is there not a single person at the activity center? Isn't there a guitar club performance today? B: You got it wrong; the performance date is next Wednesday.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 那位演員有劇場表演的經驗，所以導演決定用他。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yǎnyuán yǒu jùchǎng biǎoyǎn de jīngyàn, suǒyǐ dǎoyǎn juédìng yòng tā.
examples.english: That actor has experience in theater performances, so the director decided to use him.

examples.chinese: 在表演以前準備得越多，上舞臺就越有自信。
examples.pinyin: Zài biǎoyǎn yǐqián zhǔnbèi de yuè duō, shàng wǔtái jiù yuè yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: The more you prepare before a performance, the more confident you will be when you go on stage.

examples.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

examples.chinese: 現在去看第一場表演時間快來不及了，要不我們改看下一場吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài qù kàn dì yī chǎng biǎoyǎn shíjiān kuài láibují le, yàobù wǒmen gǎi kàn xià yì chǎng ba.
examples.english: It's almost too late to go see the first performance now; otherwise, let's watch the next one instead.

examples.chinese: 在熱鬧的都市裡，常見一些人在街頭表演。
examples.pinyin: Zài rènao de dūshì lǐ, cháng jiàn yīxiē rén zài jiētóu biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: In bustling cities, you often see some people performing in the street.

examples.chinese: 電視臺播出的娛樂節目多半是唱歌跳舞的表演，能讓觀眾心情愉快。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái bōchū de yúlè jiémù duōbàn shì chànggē tiàowǔ de biǎoyǎn, néng ràng guānzhòng xīnqíng yúkuài.
examples.english: Most of the entertainment programs broadcast by TV stations are singing and dancing performances, which can make the audience feel happy.

examples.chinese: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā de chuántǒng xìjù cháng lìyòng yǐngzi hé dēngguāng xiàoguǒ lái biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Traditional theater in some countries often uses shadows and lighting effects to perform.

examples.chinese: 章小姐接觸電影表演工作不久，雖然還是新人，對表演技巧倒是掌握得挺好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě jiēchù diànyǐng biǎoyǎn gōngzuò bùjiǔ, suīrán hái shì xīnrén, duì biǎoyǎn jìqiǎo dàoshì zhǎngwò de tǐng hǎo de.
examples.english: Miss Zhang has not been involved in film acting for long; although she is still a newcomer, she has actually mastered acting techniques quite well.

examples.chinese: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
examples.pinyin: Néng dédào guānzhòng rèqíng zhǎngshēng de biǎoyǎn, cái suànshì yǒu mèilì de biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Only a performance that can receive enthusiastic applause from the audience is considered to be a charming performance.

items.wordHook: 表(show) + 演(perform) → a performance is showing an act.

examples.chinese: 去年生日爸爸送了我一輛自行車，從那天起，我就天天騎著它去上學。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián shēngrì bàba sòng le wǒ yī liàng zìxíngchē, cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù tiāntiān qí zhe tā qù shàngxué.
examples.english: Last year on my birthday, Dad gave me a bicycle; from that day on, I have ridden it to school every day.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: A:今天天氣很好，你怎麼沒出去？ B:今天我有很多功課，不能出去玩。
examples.pinyin: A: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, nǐ zěnme méi chūqù? B: Jīntiān wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngkè, bù néng chūqù wán.
examples.english: A: The weather is so nice today; how come you didn't go out? B: I have a lot of homework today, so I can't go out and have fun.

examples.chinese: 如果明天天氣好，我就去打球。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒ jiù qù dǎ qiú.
examples.english: If the weather is good tomorrow, then I will go play ball.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不冷也不熱，很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì bù lěng yě bù rè, hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Today's weather is neither cold nor hot; it's very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，我們去海邊曬太陽吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng ba.
examples.english: The weather is nice today. Let’s go to the beach to get some sun!

examples.chinese: 今天天氣好熱。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hǎo rè.
examples.english: The weather is so hot today.

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，海邊的風景也很漂亮，我想去游泳，妳們想去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, hǎibiān de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliàng, wǒ xiǎng qù yóuyǒng, nǐmen xiǎng qù ma?
examples.english: The weather is pretty good today, so is the view at the beach. I want to go swimming. Do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

items.wordHook: Repeating 天(sky) twice for emphasis: 天天 means every day, daily.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.
examples.english: Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yǎn hǎo jiànshēn jiàoliàn de juésè, tòuguò yùndòng yǔ tiáozhěng yǐnshí, ràng shēntǐ wéichí zài zuìjiā de zhuàngtài.
examples.english: In order to play the role of a fitness coach well, he keeps his body in the best condition through exercise and diet adjustment.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 人與人之間的感情很珍貴，就算擁有再多的錢也買不到。
examples.pinyin: Rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de gǎnqíng hěn zhēnguì, jiùsuàn yōngyǒu zài duō de qián yě mǎi bù dào.
examples.english: The affection between people is very precious; even if you have a lot of money, you can't buy it.

examples.chinese: 老是忘記東西不見得是因為個性迷糊，也可能與健康有關。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshì wàngjì dōngxi bù jiànde shì yīnwèi gèxìng míhú, yě kěnéng yǔ jiànkāng yǒuguān.
examples.english: Always forgetting things is not necessarily because of an absentminded personality; it may also be related to health.

examples.chinese: 中國與美國之間的貿易問題很嚴重，這個新聞早就上電視了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǔ Měiguó zhījiān de màoyì wèntí hěn yánzhòng, zhège xīnwén zǎo jiù shàng diànshì le.
examples.english: The trade issue between China and the United States is very serious; this news appeared on TV long ago.

examples.chinese: 在學習新知識的過程中，總是會有開心與煩惱的時候。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí xīn zhīshì de guòchéng zhōng, zǒngshì huì yǒu kāixīn yǔ fánnǎo de shíhou.
examples.english: In the process of learning new knowledge, there will always be times of happiness and worry.

examples.chinese: 華人送禮最重心意，以這種方式向收禮的人表達關心與祝福。
examples.pinyin: Huárén sònglǐ zuì zhòng xīnyì, yǐ zhè zhǒng fāngshì xiàng shōu lǐ de rén biǎodá guānxīn yǔ zhùfú.
examples.english: Chinese people place the greatest value on thoughtfulness when giving gifts, using this way to express care and blessings to the recipient.

examples.chinese: 夏天一到，就有不少遊客到海灘，光著身體享受陽光與海風。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yí dào, jiù yǒu bùshǎo yóukè dào hǎitān, guāngzhe shēntǐ xiǎngshòu yángguāng yǔ hǎifēng.
examples.english: As soon as summer arrives, many tourists go to the beach, baring their bodies and enjoying the sunshine and sea breeze.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方距離公司很近，省了很多時間與交通費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng jùlí gōngsī hěn jìn, shěng le hěn duō shíjiān yǔ jiāotōngfèi.
examples.english: The place where I live is very close to the company, which saves a lot of time and transportation costs.

examples.chinese: 我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngchǎng yǔ nà jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu hézuò guānxì, chǎng nèi yuángōng rúguǒ bàomíng tāmen de lǚxíngtuán, dōu kěyǐ xiǎngshòu yōuhuì jià.
examples.english: Our factory has a partnership with that travel agency; if employees sign up for their tour group, they can all enjoy a discounted price.

examples.chinese: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào páng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shāngdiàn yǔ cāntīng, jiàrì shí xiāngdāng rènao.
examples.english: Along this street there are all kinds of shops and restaurants; on holidays it is quite bustling.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

examples.chinese: 假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú shīqù le rénmín de xìnxīn yǔ zhīchí, guójiā yě huì biàn de bù āndìng.
examples.english: If it loses the people's confidence and support, the country will also become unstable.

examples.chinese: 如果真心愛對方，就不必在乎對方的樣子與生活背景。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhēnxīn ài duìfāng, jiù búbì zàihu duìfāng de yàngzi yǔ shēnghuó bèijǐng.
examples.english: If you truly love the other person, you don't need to care about their appearance and background.

examples.chinese: 教授學生做人的道理與教授知識同樣重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu xuéshēng zuòrén de dàolǐ yǔ jiàoshòu zhīshì tóngyàng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Instructing students in the principles of how to conduct themselves is just as important as instructing them in knowledge.

examples.chinese: 當我難過的時候，最需要的是家人與好友的安慰。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ nánguò de shíhòu, zuì xūyào de shì jiārén yǔ hǎoyǒu de ānwèi.
examples.english: When I am sad, what I need most is the comfort of family and good friends.

examples.chinese: 說實話，文憑不是最重要的，重要的是個人的知識與才能。
examples.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wénpíng bù shì zuì zhòngyào de, zhòngyào de shì gèrén de zhīshì yǔ cáinéng.
examples.english: To be honest, a diploma is not the most important thing; what is important is a person's knowledge and ability.

examples.chinese: 有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu péngyǒu yǔ jiārén de gǔlì, shǐ tā zài miànduì rènhé kùnnán shí dōu shífēn zìxìn.
examples.english: With the encouragement of friends and family, he is very confident when facing any difficulty.

examples.chinese: 我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ gāozhōng tóngxué yǐ shí duō nián méi jiàn le, xiǎng zhǎo ge shìdàng shíjiān yāoqǐng dàjiā jù ju.
examples.english: I haven't seen my high school classmates for over ten years; I want to find an appropriate time to invite everyone to get together.

examples.chinese: 那家博物館平日展覽的物品很多，中多半與古代科技有關。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā bówùguǎn píngrì zhǎnlǎn de wùpǐn hěn duō, qízhōng duōbàn yǔ gǔdài kējì yǒu guān.
examples.english: That museum exhibits many items on weekdays, most of which are related to ancient technology.

examples.chinese: 這兩臺機器樣子相同，但在構造與功能上是有差別的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tái jīqì yàngzi xiāngtóng, dàn zài gòuzào yǔ gōngnéng shàng shì yǒu chābié de.
examples.english: These two machines look the same, but they differ in structure and function.

examples.chinese: 如果不與別人競爭，你就無法進步。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù yǔ biérén jìngzhēng, nǐ jiù wúfǎ jìnbù.
examples.english: If you don't compete with others, you won't be able to make progress.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要跟我一起去茶館喝杯茶？ B:與其去喝茶，我倒想去外面走走，看看花草樹木。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù cháguǎn hē bēi chá? B: Yǔqí qù hē chá, wǒ dào xiǎng qù wàimiàn zǒuzǒu, kànkan huā cǎo shùmù.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the teahouse with me to have a cup of tea? B: Rather than go drink tea, I'd actually like to go for a walk outside and look at the flowers, grass, and trees.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 古代人非常尊敬大自然，認為土地、山與河都有神。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài rén fēicháng zūnjìng dàzìrán, rènwéi tǔdì, shān yǔ hé dōu yǒu shén.
examples.english: Ancient people greatly respected nature and believed that the land, mountains, and rivers all have deities.

examples.chinese: 他與妻子雖然已結婚多年，感情仍維持得很好，真令人羨慕。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǔ qīzi suīrán yǐ jiéhūn duō nián, gǎnqíng réng wéichí de hěn hǎo, zhēn lìng rén xiànmù.
examples.english: Although he and his wife have been married for many years, their affection is still maintained very well; it truly makes people envious.

examples.chinese: 當室內與戶外溫度的差別很大時，我就容易感冒。
examples.pinyin: Dāng shìnèi yǔ hùwài wēndù de chābié hěn dà shí, wǒ jiù róngyì gǎnmào.
examples.english: When the difference between indoor and outdoor temperatures is large, I easily catch a cold.

examples.chinese: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò gǔdiǎn wénxué lái tǎolùn gǔdài yǔ xiàndài de wénhuà chāyì.
examples.english: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern times through classical literature.

examples.chinese: 電腦工程師除了維護電腦，還要處理各種與電腦相關的問題。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo gōngchéngshī chúle wéihù diànnǎo, hái yào chǔlǐ gèzhǒng yǔ diànnǎo xiāngguān de wèntí.
examples.english: Computer engineers, in addition to maintaining computers, also have to handle various computer-related problems.

examples.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
examples.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

examples.chinese: 在全球環境會議中，聯合國邀請了一些環保團體共同參與。
examples.pinyin: Zài quánqiú huánjìng huìyì zhōng, Liánhéguó yāoqǐng le yìxiē huánbǎo tuántǐ gòngtóng cānyù.
examples.english: At the global environmental conference, the United Nations invited some environmental groups to participate together.

examples.chinese: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuīdòng xuéxí gémìng, ràng xuéshēng zhǔdòng cānyǔ guīhuà kèchéng.
examples.english: She promoted a learning revolution, letting students actively participate in planning the curriculum.

examples.chinese: 與鄰居建立友好的關係，能為你帶來很多好處。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ línjū jiànlì yǒuhǎo de guānxì, néng wèi nǐ dàilái hěn duō hǎochù.
examples.english: Establishing friendly relations with neighbors can bring you many benefits.

items.wordHook: Two hands 𦥑(hands) bring 一(one) and 八(eight) together with a swift connecting stroke 丿(slash) → 與(and).

examples.chinese: 最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 生命就像一片海洋，有時穩定有時瘋狂。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng yī piàn hǎiyáng, yǒushí wěndìng yǒushí fēngkuáng.
examples.english: Life is like an ocean, sometimes stable and sometimes crazy.

examples.chinese: 這班飛機因為天氣不穩定，所以誤點了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì bù wěndìng, suǒyǐ wùdiǎn le.
examples.english: This flight was behind schedule because the weather was unstable.

examples.chinese: 天氣不穩定的時候，氣溫也時時跟著變化(to change,to vary)。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì bù wěndìng de shíhou, qìwēn yě shíshí gēnzhe biànhuà.
examples.english: When the weather is unstable, the temperature also constantly changes along with it.

examples.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
examples.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

items.wordHook: Combining 穩(steady) and 定(decide): 穩定 means stable.

examples.chinese: 過海關時，請配合相關人員檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Guò hǎiguān shí, qǐng pèihé xiāngguān rényuán jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: When going through customs, please cooperate with the relevant personnel in inspecting your luggage.

examples.chinese: 根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒushù de zhǒnglèi, bìngrén zài dòng shǒushù qián néng chī de shíwù yě bù tài xiāngtóng.
examples.english: Depending on the type of surgery, the food patients can eat before undergoing surgery is also not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù yīyuàn guīdìng, jìnrù bìngfáng hòu jìnzhǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: According to hospital regulations, after entering the ward, speaking loudly is prohibited.

examples.chinese: 看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào zìjǐ guójiā de guóqí jìnrù Àoyùn huìchǎng, mínzhòng yě búduàn huī zhe shǒu shàng de xiǎo qízi, tì zìjǐ de guójiā jiāyóu.
examples.english: Seeing their country's national flag enter the Olympic venue, the public also continuously waved the small flags in their hands to cheer for their country.

items.wordHook: Combining 位(seat) and 置(lay out): 位置 means location.
Combining 利(gains) and 益(profit): 利益 means interest, benefit, advantage.
杯(cup) + 子(noun suffix) → a little cup: 杯子(cup).
Combining 根(root) and 據(possess): 根據 means according to.
a 木(tree) frame rests beside 弟(young brother) → step up the 梯(ladder).
沒(not) + 問(ask) + 題(question) → no question, so no problem.
Combining 海(sea) and 灘(rapids): 海灘 means beach.
A fierce 犭(dog) lunges past a kneeling 卩(seal) sentry, daring to 犯(commit) a crime.
聲(voice) + 音(sound) → 聲音 is a sound or voice.
When 止(stop) meets ⺼(meat), you stop eating and nod 肯(agree).
黑(black) + 色(color) → the color black: 黑色(black).
